baseline_note: Master advanced by two commits; prior published reports remain pinned to their old comparison. Audited production source and merge base unchanged.
scope: Incremental refinement only, not a repeated full file classification or intent selection

candidates.status: ready for intent selection, not selected or proved
candidates.whole_property: For a selected nonempty branch f1/f2/f3/f4 under its actual equations and direction/length guards, interpreted Y^N equals X^M concatenated with the emitted residual z.
requirements: Use body-defined word power with nonpositive exponents yielding epsilon, concatenation and slices, not unconstrained length/count proxies.
Preserve f1 N>=1; f2 M>=1 and conditional nonnegative residual inference only when the root is nonempty; an unconstrained fresh root may be empty and N is not explicitly bounded there.
Preserve f3 M,N>=2, symbolic k unbounded below, and distinguish period-param construction from fresh p1/p2 with its asserted X equation.
Preserve f4 M=1, q>=0, q+1<=N, and prefix/suffix orientation.
No claim of branch exhaustiveness, dependency/broadcast lifetime safety, or arithmetic-engine correspondence.

candidates.status: possible supporting helper/whole obligation; avoid double counting
candidates.whole_property: A valid period r and the actual suffix/slice construction yield X=(p1.p2)^floor(|X|/r).p1; period need not divide length.
requirements: Read and preserve has_period body, r>0 and r<|X| from enumeration, and l1=|X| mod r.
Do not silently replace suffix p1 by a prefix without proving equality.
No full-trichotomy completeness claim; admit unsigned length-sum limits explicitly.

candidates.status: deferred pending caller-justified global substitution invariant
candidates.observation: on_stack.remove(t) precedes on_stack.contains(t); obj_hashtable uses pointer-set removal, so that test does not provide an ancestor-cycle guard.
requirements: All 24 production broadcast call sites are enumerated, but representative occurs checks do not prove a global acyclic latest-binding graph.
The central broadcaster dispatches to every sink without a uniform occurs check; eq_facet::apply_subst appends newest bindings and does not normalize earlier substitution RHS vectors.
Do not invent fuel or assume acyclicity/rank as a proved caller fact; do not claim a reachable cycle, hang or crash.

candidates.status: confirmed representation mismatch observation; primarily missed-hit/performance scope, not solver-unsoundness evidence
candidates.observation: constraint_store interns via pointee hash/equals and owns clones; vector<constraint_i const*>::contains compares pointer identity. Equation clone() allocates a different live object.
requirements: Current watched id can be semantically active through find(), while another canonical clone is absent by pointer comparison despite an equal live fact.
A small explicit identity-versus-value model could assess the documented rewatch iff contract, but must label a converse failure as missed-hit behavior, not unsound SAT/UNSAT.
No compiled execution, native cache-hit measurement or general cache correctness proof.

candidates.observation: Leaf-subset filtering alone is not a proof that retained live facts semantically entail a contradiction.
requirements: Need all conflict-dependency producers, excluded-facet meaning, substitution and derived-fact provenance, not an assumed unsat-core oracle.
A mechanical subset-filter proof must not replace the original semantic soundness goal or count it as closed.

candidates.status: optional distinct whole-function control gate, not a replacement for cache soundness
candidates.whole_property: Eligibility holds exactly when no present signature-excluded facet reports live unsatisfied state.
requirements: Facet presence/signature/satisfaction are disclosed observations; preserve the complete actual loop and early return.
This proves only the admission gate, not that any cached core is unsatisfiable; select only if useful, not to fill quota.

p13: Complete queue property remains unresolved; not replaced by a weaker goal.
